Record has 1845 and 1846; sources give completion on 4 Dec 1845 and fitting-out finished in 1846.

notes_for_editor: Mostly secondary sources (Lighthouse Friends cites PEI Assembly journals and Marine reports but I could not read them). Keeper dates differ between Lighthouse Friends and the museum list; the 1897 Gillis appointment was matched by column position in an OCR'd table (Dec. 10, 1897 against Point Prim). The Nova Scotia 'Point Prim' (Digby Gut) also appears in the Marine reports; I excluded it. PEI Society says 'only stone lighthouse' and '1947' (apparent slip); not repeated. Pilot's name is as Lighthouse Friends spells it; omitted from the story. Keeper's daughter not named. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Gillis/Point Prim/Dec. 10, 1897 confirmed on the page image (printed p. 69, same row). The 1910-11 table (printed p. 253) prints the same date against Alex. McRae at Pointe Prim; unexplained (possibly carried over), not used. Ownership differs between Rowlett (owner BCDC) and Lighthouse Friends (leased by Coast Guard); stated in text. Lens location: Lighthouse Friends says 'first-floor'.
